categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Robots.txt is properly configured allowing search engine crawlers and blocking /admin and /api
Canonical tags are set dynamically via SEOHead component on key pages
Clean routing structure with React Router and framer-motion transitions

findings.title: SPA Client-Side Rendering Limits Non-JS Crawlers (Bing, AI Bots)
findings.description: The site is rendered entirely client-side. Non-JS or limited-JS crawlers (like Bingbot fallback or lightweight AI bots) only parse static HTML, missing dynamic page titles and meta descriptions.
findings.recommendation: Implement static prerendering (SSG/Vite-SSG) or Edge Prerendering for public landing pages.

findings.title: Sitemap Missing Route Aliases & Dynamic Updates
findings.description: Route aliases (/wedding-venue-in-bhaktapur, /catering-service-in-bhaktapur) are defined in App.tsx but omitted from sitemap.xml. Lastmod dates are hardcoded to 2025-07-16.
findings.recommendation: Update sitemap.xml to include all indexable routes and automate lastmod updates.

categories.name: Bing & IndexNow
what_works: Robots.txt explicitly specifies sitemap location for Bingbot discovery

findings.title: Missing IndexNow Protocol Implementation
findings.description: No IndexNow key hosted at public root. New packages, blog posts, or updates cannot be pushed instantly to Bing / Copilot index.
findings.recommendation: Generate 32-char hex IndexNow key file in public/ and submit key via IndexNow API.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: Verified capacity (700-800 guests) and 7 verified event types clearly communicated
Strong local authority with exact address near Suryabinayak Ganesh Mandir, Bhaktapur
Direct contact phone (+977 986-0117006) and WhatsApp integration

findings.title: Client Verification Needed for Facilities & Packages
findings.description: Exact parking capacity, hall breakdown names, and structured package pricing require confirmed details to maximize E-E-A-T.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit parking capacity numbers and detailed hall features to About and Location pages.

categories.name: Schema & Structured Data
what_works: Organization and WebSite JSON-LD graph present in index.html
EventVenue schema with exact GeoCoordinates (27.6568562, 85.4217854) in Home.tsx

findings.title: FAQPage Schema Rich Result Deprecation Notice
findings.description: Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites on May 7, 2026. FAQPage schema won't trigger SERP drop-down features.
findings.recommendation: Retain FAQ content for user experience and GEO, but do not rely on FAQPage schema for SERP rich snippets.

findings.title: Missing Dual CateringService / FoodEstablishment Schema
findings.description: Site offers both venue rental and catering services, but catering service schema graph is not attached to homepage.
findings.recommendation: Add CateringService schema to homepage and /catering-service-bhaktapur page.

categories.name: Performance & Core Web Vitals
what_works: Lazy loading implemented for all React route components
Vite build tool ensures modern code splitting

findings.title: Heavy 2.17MB Uncompressed PNG Asset
findings.description: shreeganeshpartyvenue(withbg-of-white).png is 2.17 MB. Loaded as default og:image and favicon image.
findings.recommendation: Compress image to WebP/AVIF (<150KB) and rename to remove parenthesis characters.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)

findings.title: Missing public/llms.txt File
findings.description: AI engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) look for /llms.txt for concise site documentation.
findings.recommendation: Create public/llms.txt summarizing venue specifications, capacity, contact info, and services.
